regime_context: The detector flags Semiconductors as the prevailing leadership theme with a moderate trend (durability 0.58) but narrow breadth (36%). AI Compute is a close challenger with mixed trend quality. Innovative Pharma & CXO shows the strongest durability (0.85) and high breadth (86%) but is crowded. Historically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown in this tape (gate_helps=false), so eligibility is experimental. Macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and AI narratives with an unusually high unscheduled news share. Given the detector's non-predictive design and a previous hit rate of 29%, any lean is highly conditional and conviction is low.

theses.subject: Semiconductors

theses.dissent: Crowding often precedes sharp reversals in a mean-reverting tape; the detector's trend gate failed here historically, so the durability signal may be a coincident artifact.
